points.title: 皇室降生
points.description: 1530年8月25日，伊凡·瓦西里耶维奇出生于莫斯科克里姆林宫，是瓦西里三世与第二任妻子叶莲娜·格林斯卡娅的独子。作为莫斯科大公国的继承人，他的出生被视为国家未来的希望。然而，他的童年并不幸福，父亲在他三岁时去世，母亲在他八岁时也突然离世，使他成为孤儿，由贵族波雅尔们组成的摄政委员会管理国家。
points.descriptionEn: On August 25, 1530, Ivan IV Vasilyevich was born in the Moscow Kremlin, the only son of Grand Prince Vasily III and his second wife Elena Glinskaya. As the heir to the Grand Duchy of Moscow, his birth was seen as hope for the nation's future. However, his childhood was unhappy; his father died when he was three, and his mother died unexpectedly when he was eight, making him an orphan under the regency council of boyars.

points.title: 沙皇加冕
points.description: 1547年1月16日，17岁的伊凡在莫斯科圣母升天大教堂正式加冕为沙皇，成为俄罗斯历史上第一位正式使用'沙皇'头衔的统治者。这一举动标志着俄罗斯从大公国向沙皇国的转变。在此期间，他进行了多项改革：建立了沙皇专制制度，颁布了新的法典，设立了缙绅会议，并开始宗教改革。他还于1552年征服喀山汗国，1556年征服阿斯特拉罕汗国，极大地扩展了俄罗斯的领土。
points.descriptionEn: On January 16, 1547, the 17-year-old Ivan was officially crowned Tsar in the Cathedral of the Dormition in Moscow, becoming the first Russian ruler to use the title 'Tsar.' This marked Russia's transition from a grand duchy to a tsardom. During this period, he implemented numerous reforms: established the tsarist autocracy, issued new legal codes, established the Zemsky Sobor, and began religious reforms. He also conquered the Khanate of Kazan in 1552 and the Astrakhan Khanate in 1556, significantly expanding Russian territory.

points.title: 恐怖统治
points.description: 1560年，伊凡的第一任妻子安娜斯塔西娅去世后，他的性格开始变得多疑和残暴。他开始怀疑贵族们对他妻子的死负有责任，并逐渐建立起秘密警察组织' oprichnina'，对贵族进行残酷镇压。1565年，他将全国分为 oprichnina（沙皇直接管辖区）和 zemshchina（普通行政区），在 oprichnina区域内实行恐怖统治。1570年，他血洗诺夫哥罗德，指控贵族叛乱，导致数千人被杀。这一时期，大量贵族被处决或流放，伊凡获得了'雷帝'的称号。
points.descriptionEn: After the death of his first wife Anastasia in 1560, Ivan's character became increasingly paranoid and brutal. He began to suspect the nobles were responsible for his wife's death and established the secret police organization 'oprichnina' to brutally suppress the aristocracy. In 1565, he divided Russia into oprichnina (territory directly under the tsar) and zemshchina (regular administrative regions), implementing a reign of terror in the oprichnina. In 1570, he massacred Novgorod, accusing the nobles of treason, resulting in thousands of deaths. During this period, numerous nobles were executed or exiled, earning Ivan the title 'Terrible.'

points.title: 对外扩张
points.description: 1572年，伊凡解散了 oprichnina，但他的对外扩张政策仍在继续。1579年，他发动了针对西伯利亚汗国的远征，由叶尔马克·齐莫菲耶维奇率领，最终导致西伯利亚并入俄罗斯。他还与立窝尼亚骑士团进行了长达25年的立窝尼亚战争，虽然最终未能完全控制波罗的海地区，但这场战争消耗了国力，导致俄罗斯经济衰退。在此期间，他建立了俄罗斯第一支正规海军，并在伏尔加河流域建立了贸易网络。
points.descriptionEn: In 1572, Ivan dissolved the oprichnina, but his foreign expansion policies continued. In 1579, he launched an expedition against the Khanate of Siberia, led by Yermak Timofeyevich, which eventually led to Siberia's incorporation into Russia. He also fought the 25-year Livonian War against the Livonian Order, which, though failing to secure complete control of the Baltic region, exhausted Russia's resources and caused economic decline. During this period, he established Russia's first regular navy and created trade networks along the Volga River.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 1580年后，伊凡的健康状况急剧恶化，精神更加不稳定。他与儿子伊凡的冲突加剧，在一次争吵中，他亲手用权杖击打儿子的头部，导致伊凡重伤身亡。1584年3月18日，伊凡雷帝在莫斯科去世，享年54岁。他的死因不明，有说法是自然死亡，也有传言是被毒杀。他死后，由较为温和的儿子费多尔继位，但俄罗斯的实际权力逐渐落入贵族手中。伊凡雷帝的统治对俄罗斯历史产生了深远影响，他建立了中央集权的沙皇专制制度，为俄罗斯后来的帝国扩张奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After 1580, Ivan's health deteriorated rapidly, and his mental instability increased. His conflicts with his son Ivan intensified, and during an argument, he struck his son on the head with a scepter, causing fatal injuries. On March 18, 1584, Ivan the Terrible died in Moscow at the age of 54. The cause of his death is unclear, with some suggesting natural causes and others claiming poisoning. After his death, his milder son Fyodor ascended the throne, but real power gradually fell into the hands of the nobility. Ivan's reign had a profound impact on Russian history, establishing the centralized tsarist autocracy that laid the foundation for Russia's later imperial expansion.

appraisal.zh: 伊凡雷帝在史学与流行文化中是一个复杂而矛盾的人物：他结束了蒙古统治的残余，统一俄罗斯领土，建立中央集权的沙皇专制，被视为俄罗斯民族国家的奠基人，其改革加强了国家管理并促进了文化发展；但另一种看法认为，他同样是残暴的独裁者，恐怖统治导致大量无辜者死亡，oprichnina 制度对贵族进行系统性清洗、削弱了行政能力，对外战争虽扩展领土却耗尽国力、导致经济衰退，其精神不稳定与暴力被视为专制权力的腐蚀性体现，并为后来的专制传统树立了不良先例。学界普遍视其统治为俄罗斯历史的关键转折点，积极与灾难性后果并存，影响延续至今。
appraisal.en: In scholarship and popular culture Ivan the Terrible is a complex and contradictory figure: he ended the remnants of Mongol rule, unified Russian territories and established a centralized tsarist autocracy, and is regarded as the founder of the Russian nation-state, his reforms strengthening state administration and promoting cultural development. Yet another view holds that he was equally a brutal dictator whose reign of terror killed many innocent people, whose oprichnina systematically purged the aristocracy and weakened administrative capacity, and whose foreign wars, though expanding territory, exhausted the country and caused economic decline; his mental instability and violence are seen as evidence of the corrupting nature of autocratic power and set a negative precedent for later autocratic traditions. Historians generally treat his reign as a critical turning point in Russian history, with positive and disastrous consequences alike whose effects persist.

supporter.zh: 伊凡雷帝被视为俄罗斯民族国家的奠基人。他结束了蒙古统治的残余，统一了俄罗斯领土，建立了中央集权的沙皇专制制度，为俄罗斯后来的帝国扩张奠定了基础。他的改革措施加强了国家管理，促进了俄罗斯文化发展，使俄罗斯成为欧洲不可忽视的力量。支持者认为，他的严厉手段在当时混乱的政治环境中是必要的，他为俄罗斯民族认同的形成做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Ivan the Terrible is regarded as the founder of the Russian nation-state. He ended the remnants of Mongol rule, unified Russian territories, and established a centralized tsarist autocracy that laid the foundation for Russia's later imperial expansion. His reforms strengthened state administration and promoted cultural development, making Russia a force to be reckoned with in Europe. Supporters argue that his harsh measures were necessary in the chaotic political environment of the time, and he made an indelible contribution to the formation of Russian national identity.

critic.zh: 批评者认为伊凡雷帝是残暴的独裁者，他的恐怖统治导致大量无辜者死亡，严重破坏了俄罗斯的社会结构。他的 oprichnina 制度是对贵族阶层的系统性清洗，削弱了国家的行政能力。他的对外战争虽然扩展了领土，但也耗尽了国力，导致经济衰退。批评者指出，他的精神不稳定和暴力行为反映了专制权力的腐蚀性，他的统治方式为后来的俄罗斯专制传统树立了不良先例。
critic.en: Critics view Ivan the Terrible as a brutal dictator whose reign of terror resulted in the deaths of many innocent people and severely damaged Russia's social structure. His oprichnina system represented a systematic purge of the aristocracy, weakening the state's administrative capacity. Although his foreign wars expanded territory, they exhausted national resources and caused economic decline. Critics point out that his mental instability and violent behavior reflected the corrupting nature of autocratic power, and his ruling set a negative precedent for Russia's later autocratic traditions.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，伊凡雷帝是一个复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是俄罗斯民族国家的奠基人，也是残暴的独裁者；既是改革者，也是暴君。他的统治反映了俄罗斯从封建制度向中央集权国家过渡的痛苦过程。在流行文化中，他的形象被多次塑造，从电影到文学，展现了人们对权力与暴力的永恒思考。历史学家普遍认为，伊凡雷帝的统治是俄罗斯历史上的关键转折点，他的政策既有积极的一面，也有灾难性的后果，其影响一直延续到现代俄罗斯的政治文化中。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Ivan the Terrible is a complex and contradictory figure. He is both the founder of the Russian nation-state and a brutal dictator; both a reformer and a tyrant. His reign reflects the painful transition of Russia from feudalism to a centralized state. In popular culture, his image has been portrayed numerous times in films and literature, reflecting humanity's eternal contemplation of power and violence. Historians generally agree that Ivan's reign was a critical turning point in Russian history, with policies that had both positive aspects and disastrous consequences, whose effects continue to influence modern Russian political culture.

self.zh: 我宁愿做莫斯科的沙皇，也不愿做全世界的皇帝。
self.en: I would rather be the tsar of Moscow than the emperor of the whole world.
